title: Twenty-sided polynomial tag decoding with two entries per side and prefix scoring with local leader overlap caps with cumulative side pair caps and column-prefix pair caps with single-mask summed distances

claims.statement: The fixed product of two [1000,500] components with length-twenty polynomial tags and two relative-list entries per side has average block error at most 969315802566548673/1000000000000000000 on the 2000-use BSC(1/10) for uniform 1000-bit data, when decoded by the counted program in proof.md.
The same bsc-ops-v1 program executes exactly W=22326657838 primitives for every received word and W<=2^(687561/20000).

experiments.purpose: Verify local tag spectra, exact quotient ranks and cumulative side-cap support profiles in this sector. The last run combines the checked arrays and verifies the exact error and fixed work bounds.
